pages.title: Market Sentiment Analysis
pages.text: /* 1. Layout & Global */ #sidebar, #secondary, .widget-area { display: none !important; } #main { width: 100% !important; float: none !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .container { max-width: 1600px !important; width: 98% !important; } .sentiment-wrapper { text-align: center; padding: 25px; background: #fdfdfd; border-radius: 15px; font-family: sans-serif; } .time-tabs { margin: 0 auto 30px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .tab-btn { padding: 12px 22px; border: 2px solid #eeeeee; background-color: #ffffff !important; color: #444444 !important; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .tab-btn.active { background-color: #26a69a !important; color: #ffffff !important; border-color: #26a69a; } /* 2. Charts Layout */ .chart-container { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; gap: 20px; width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; } .chart-box { flex: 1; min-width: 420px; height: 500px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } /* 3. F&G Index & Sigma Formula Section */ .fng-container { width: 100%; margin-top: 30px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } .formula-math { margin: 20px auto 0; padding: 20px; background: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 12px; border-top: 3px solid #26a69a; max-width: 800px; } .sigma-formula { font-size: 1.5rem; color: #2c3e50; margin-bottom: 15px; font-style: italic; } .comp-legend { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; font-size: 13px; color: #666; text-align: left; padding: 0 10px; } .comp-legend b { color: #26a69a; } Live 1 Min 15 Min 1 Hour 1 Day 1 Week 1 Month Index = ∑i=15 (wi × ci) w₁ (30%): Volatility w₂ (30%): Momentum w₃ (20%): Social Media w₄ (10%): Dominance w₅ (10%): Trends (function() { let btcWs, ethWs, charts = {}; const syms = ['BTCUSDT', 'ETHUSDT']; function getPieOpt(s, n) { return { title: { text: s + ' Inflow vs Outflow (' + n + ')', left: 'center', top: '2%', textStyle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 'bold' } }, tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}{c} ({d}%)' }, legend: { bottom: '2%', icon: 'circle' }, series: [{ type: 'pie', radius: ['45%', '70%'], itemStyle: { borderRadius: 10, borderColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 4 }, label: { show: true, formatter: '{b}\n{d}%' }, data: [{value:0, name:'Inflow (Buy)'}, {value:0, name:'Outflow (Sell)'}] }] }; } async function updateCharts(p) { if (btcWs) btcWs.close(); if (ethWs) ethWs.close(); for (const s of syms) { const c = charts[s]; if (!c) continue; c.showLoading({ text: 'Loading...', color: '#26a69a' }); if (p === 'live') { let b=0, se=0; const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${s.toLowerCase()}@trade`); if (s === 'BTCUSDT') btcWs = ws; else ethWs = ws; ws.onmessage = (e) => { const d = JSON.parse(e.data); d.m ? se += parseFloat(d.q) : b += parseFloat(d.q); c.setOption({series:[{data:[{value:b.toFixed(3), name:'Inflow (Buy)', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}},{value:se.toFixed(3), name:'Outflow (Sell)', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}}]}]}); }; c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, 'Live')); } else { try { const res = await fetch(`https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${s}&interval=${p}&limit=1`); const data = await res.json(); c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, p.toUpperCase())); const buy = parseFloat(data[0][9]), total = parseFloat(data[0][5]); c.setOption({series:[{data:[{value:buy.toFixed(2), name:'Inflow (Buy)', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}},{value:(total-buy).toFixed(2), name:'Outflow (Sell)', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}}]}]}); } catch(e) { console.error(e); } } c.hideLoading(); } } async function updateFnG() { try { const res = await fetch('https://api.alternative.me/fng/'); const json = await res.json(); const val = parseInt(json.data[0].value); const label = json.data[0].value_classification; const fngChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('fng-chart')); fngChart.setOption({ title: { text: 'Crypto Fear & Greed Index', left: 'center', top: '5%', textStyle: { fontSize: 22 } }, series: [{ type: 'gauge', center: ['50%', '65%'], startAngle: 200, endAngle: -20, min: 0, max: 100, axisLine: { lineStyle: { width: 30, color: [[0.25, '#ef5350'], [0.5, '#ffa726'], [0.75, '#ffee58'], [1, '#26a69a']] } }, progress: { show: true, width: 30 }, detail: { valueAnimation: true, formatter: '{value}\n{label|' + label + '}', offsetCenter: [0, '35%'], fontSize: 45, rich: { label: { fontSize: 20, color: '#666' } } }, data: [{ value: val }] }] }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } window.addEventListener('load', () => { syms.forEach(s => { charts[s] = echarts.init(document.getElementById(s === 'BTCUSDT' ? 'btc-chart' : 'eth-chart')); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); this.classList.add('active'); updateCharts(this.dataset.p); }; }); updateCharts('1m'); updateFnG(); }); })();
